server.login.title: Sign in to Larynx
server.login.heading: Your people, together.
server.login.description: Sign in securely with a passkey, or start with your email.
server.login.newDevice: Register this browser as a new device (for a revoked or lost device session).
server.login.recoveryNote: Recovery replaces all passkeys and signs out all devices. It cannot restore encrypted history or encryption keys.
server.login.recoveryAck: I understand the recovery changes above (required for recovery).
server.login.fine: Your passkey stays with your device or password manager.
server.complete.title: Account ready
server.complete.heading: Your account is ready
server.complete.description: Return to the Larynx app and choose Sign in to continue.
server.browser.rateLimit: Please wait a few minutes and try again.
server.browser.failure: Unable to continue. Check your code, or try signing in or recovering your account.
server.browser.cancelled: Passkey request cancelled. You can try again.
server.browser.recoveryAck: Please confirm that you understand account recovery.
server.browser.sent: Check your email for a verification code. If a code does not arrive, wait a few minutes before trying again.
server.oauth.title: Larynx authorization
server.oauth.unavailable: Unable to continue authorization. Return to the app and try again.
server.scope.profile:read: Read your account profile and devices
server.mail.verificationInstructions: Paste this code into the browser where you requested it within 10 minutes. It can be used once. Never share it.
server.mail.recoveryWarning: Recovery replaces your passkeys and signs out all devices. It does not restore encrypted history or encryption keys.
server.mail.ignore: If you did not request this, ignore this message.
server.mail.invitationIntro: Someone invited you to Larynx. Open {{url}}, sign in or create an account, then paste this invitation code:
server.mail.invitationInstructions: The invitation expires after seven days. A resent invitation replaces the previous code. Opening this email grants no access. Request a fresh verification code before accepting. If this is unexpected, ignore it.
server.mail.proofInstructions: Paste this code into the signed-in app where you requested it within ten minutes. Sign in with the account already registered to this email. Accepting joins only the selected invitation and does not add a recovery email. Never share the code. If you did not request this, ignore it.
